coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of seven ground-truth variable items match fully: the two baseline prompts, the 23-task BBH benchmark, and the 20% optimization/80% testing split. This yields 43%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design does not specify the required PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer and text-bison scorer, instead offering alternative optimizers and an unspecified scorer. Optimization starts from eight seed instructions rather than only an empty instruction. Final training accuracy relative to the baselines is not reported as an outcome; formal comparisons instead use test accuracy. Although per-task comparisons are included, the expected improvement of over 5% in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks is missing.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to conclude that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on most tasks, demonstrating their superiority over standard or naive instructions.
